purpose: Fresh ordinary-language source-scope and three-turn context diagnostic. No product accuracy estimate or 95-percent claim.
freezeOrder: Review canonical source scope/definitions/tables/exceptions and real resolver availability.
Freeze fixtures, keys, packets, audit and this protocol; no paid answers precede that freeze.
Root may inspect only development prompts for implementation.
Root freezes the candidate/source hashes before opening or running reserved prompts.
Run reserved questions with normal history and identical explicit project facts; never send answer checks, source references, metadata, keys or packets to models.
Review actual operative answers/citations/packets against keys; verifier approval is not correctness.
Any candidate edit after inspecting reserved outcomes turns this cohort into a regression diagnostic; a later fresh reserved cohort is required for another untouched evaluation.

runtimePolicy.models: Existing current Luna writer low / verifier medium; no model overrides by fixture author.
runtimePolicy.budget: Use existing shared $13.97 campaign ledger; fixture author makes zero paid calls and adds no separate allowance.
runtimePolicy.projectIsolation: Runner creates isolated fictional project IDs and normalizes through researchProjectInformation; no production user project/history mutation.
runtimePolicy.sourceAvailabilityRead: Actual resolver audit disabled API key and semantic search; no answer generation or retrieval optimization.

grading.rule: Grade directly asked operative rule and supplied facts; conditional qualifications must be truthful and scoped. Withholding a directly supported narrow answer is unsuccessful. No provider mode/verification boolean alone establishes correctness.
grading.coverage: Inspect actual supplied operative clauses, complete exceptions and table rows separately from answer correctness; expected source ID presence alone is not coverage.
grading.keyFlawPolicy: Record ambiguous/flawed keys separately without rewriting frozen prompts or scoring them as wrong answers.
grading.reviewAuthority: Assistant source review; licensed professional adjudication not established.

reporting: Report all36 turns and12 scenario-family outcomes, initial turns and follow-ups separately, six code-family subsets, project-fact/correction handling, stages, actual decisive-text coverage, latency, estimated/provider-accounting limitations and source/output hashes.
Do not treat36 turns as independent samples. Three turns in each scenario share facts/rules; adjacent chapters may correlate prior campaigns.
No representative population sampling, professional adjudication or production cold-start evidence is established.
The result cannot support an overall95-percent product accuracy statement.
